name: dynamite-blast
description: Dynamite (D-100): the attack button sets a stick down; it needs a Torch to light; lit, it burns 4 s and blows: a wood wall next to it is wrecked, a Troll next to it loses only a fifth of the building damage (30 of 150 blunt, its armour aside), and a round hole about 1.5 m deep is dug where it stood; the test puts the ground back.
